statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
Clinical evaluation suggests intermittent high-grade conduction abnormalities or arrhythmic pauses
These abnormalities are not captured on standard electrocardiography
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is necessary to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
Diagnosis codes R55, I48.91, and I49.5 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
